body: ABOUT ROBYLO
ROBYLO is an independent digital studio helping small businesses build a stronger online presence, reach more customers, and make technology work for them.
Based in the Chicago area. Built around direct communication, practical solutions, and personal accountability.
THE PERSON BEHIND ROBYLO
I'm Vitalii Vozniak, the founder of ROBYLO.
I work across web development, digital marketing, and business technology — bringing these areas together to solve practical problems for small businesses.

Today, I personally plan, build, and manage every ROBYLO project. I use modern tools, including AI, to work more efficiently, while keeping the decisions, implementation, and responsibility in my hands.
No unnecessary layers between you and the work being done.
Vitalii Vozniak
Founder, ROBYLO
THE IDEA
A website, search visibility, advertising, and business systems shouldn't operate as disconnected pieces.
ROBYLO brings them together with one practical goal: helping small businesses build a digital presence that supports how they actually work.
Sometimes that means building a better website. Sometimes it's improving how customers find you, simplifying a process, or connecting tools that should already be working together.
The right solution starts with understanding the problem — not selling another service.
THE DIFFERENCE
Talk directly with the person responsible for your project. No unnecessary handoffs or layers of management.
Your website, marketing, and business tools should support each other, not compete for attention.
Recommendations are based on what your business needs, not on adding more tools, features, or complexity.
Clear ownership of the work, straightforward communication, and responsibility for the decisions being made.
GO DEEPER
Explore real projects and the digital solutions behind them.
See how we move from understanding a business problem to building a practical solution.
Have a project in mind or a business problem you're trying to solve? Let's talk about what makes sense.
